townhall.aoe: Town Center · 4×4 in the genre (3×3 here)
townhall.truth: Big hipped or thatched roof over an open, pillared ground floor; a side tower; a flag.
townhall.delight: Villagers glimpsed inside; flag waving; chimney smoke in the Imperial Age.

house.truth: Dark Age wattle hut with thatch → Feudal timber frame → Castle half-timber and tile → Imperial stone.
house.delight: Door in team colour; chimney smoke; the roof should appear late in construction, not the door first.

farm.truth: Rows of crops inside a wooden fence, a worn path, crops turning golden when mature.
farm.delight: Rows that visibly grow; fence posts at the corners.

lumber.truth: Open shed, stacked logs, saw horse, an axe left in a stump.
lumber.delight: Wood chips on the ground; the log pile grows with deliveries.

mine.truth: Timber headframe over a pit, an ore cart, piles of gold and stone.

mill.truth: Stone base with windmill sails in the Western set; Dark Age mill is a hut with a hand quern and grain sacks.
mill.delight: Turning sails (already); sacks of grain by the door.

barracks.truth: Fortified yard with corner turrets, a straw training dummy, a spear rack, a banner.
barracks.delight: Banner in team colour; dummy with a few arrows in it.

archery.truth: A tent or awning plus straw targets with red and white rings.
archery.delight: Arrows stuck in the target; awning edge in team colour.

stable.truth: Long roof over open stalls with horses, hay bales, a fenced paddock.
stable.delight: Horse heads in the stalls; hay.

siege.aoe: Siege Workshop · 4×4 in the genre (3×3 here)
siege.truth: Half-built engines, an A-frame crane, stacked wheels, timber piles.
siege.delight: A spare wheel leaning on the wall.

smith.truth: Forge chimney with smoke, an anvil, hanging tools, a glow in the doorway.

temple.truth: Western set: a chapel with a bell tower, round window and cross. The dome belongs to the Middle Eastern set.
temple.delight: Stored relics show as a faint gold glow in the window.

tower.truth: Round or square stone tower with a wooden hoarding; taller with each upgrade.
tower.delight: Arrow slits; a flag at the top.

dock.truth: Piers on stilts over water, a boathouse, a crane, nets and barrels.
dock.delight: Water lines lapping at the posts.

market.truth: Stalls with striped awnings, pots, cloth and fruit around a courtyard.
market.delight: Awning in team colour; goods on the tables.

wonder.truth: Britons: Chichester Cathedral; Franks: Chartres. Gothic: spire, rose window, flying buttresses.

wall.truth: Palisade (wood) in the Dark Age, stone from Feudal; segments connect to each other.
wall.delight: Crenellations that line up across segments.

gate.truth: An arch with a portcullis between two flanking towers.
gate.delight: The portcullis lifts for friendly units.

keep.truth: Tall keep, four corner towers, battlements, flags, a gate.
keep.delight: Flags at the corners; arrow slits.

villager.truth: Tunic, a tool in hand (axe, pick, sickle, hammer) and the carried resource visible: logs on the shoulder, a basket, a sack.

swordsman.truth: Sword and round shield; a helmet from Man-at-Arms up.

spearman.truth: Spear taller than the man, small shield, pointed cap.

archer.truth: Bow, quiver on the back, no armour.

skirmisher.truth: Bundle of javelins, small round shield, light hide armour.

horseman.truth: Light horse without barding; rider with a spear.

scout.truth: Light horse, no helmet, no armour; the fastest thing on the map.

camelrider.truth: Tan camel with a hump; rider with spear or sword.

warelephant.truth: Big grey elephant with a howdah or an armoured rider; slow and heavy.

longbow.truth: A yew bow as tall as the archer, green hood, quiver, no armour.

crossbowguard.truth: Crossbow held level and a tall pavise shield.

axethrower.truth: Throwing axe, Frankish helmet; the axe arcs through the air.

horsearcher.truth: Light horse and a bow, shooting while riding.

catapult.truth: Mangonel: a four-wheel cart with a throwing arm and bucket.

ram.truth: Covered ram: a roofed hut on wheels with the log protruding; the crew is hidden.

trebuchet.truth: Packed: a wheeled frame. Unpacked: tall A-frame, counterweight and sling.

monk.truth: Hooded robe, staff or cross; a relic held overhead glows gold.

tradecart.truth: Ox pulling a two-wheel covered cart.

fishing.truth: Small boat with a mast and a net over the side.

transport.truth: Wide flat hull with low sides for cargo.

warship.truth: Galley: long hull, oars, ram prow, a sail.

sheep.truth: White fleece, black face; shows an owner marker when captured.

deer.truth: Tan hide, stag antlers; flees when approached.

wood.truth: Oak with a round three-tone canopy or a pine of stacked cones; a stump when depleted.

food.truth: Berry bush: a dark green mound with red berries. Fish: ripples and silver shapes on water.

gold.truth: A rock pile with yellow nuggets that glint.
